_comment: Execution mode configurations - editable without code changes
_session_history_comment: Max messages to keep in session history (prevents stale command re-execution)

plan.prompt_suffix: PLANNING MODE: Create a detailed step-by-step plan for this task. List each action you would take, but DO NOT execute any commands or tools. Format as numbered steps. After planning, wait for user to say 'execute' or 'go ahead' before taking action.
plan.description: Planning only - no execution until approved

quick.prompt_suffix: Be concise and direct. You have a maximum of 8 tool calls - plan efficiently. Skip verification for simple tasks.
quick.description: Fast execution for simple queries and status checks

balanced.prompt_suffix: You have up to 20 tool calls available. Plan your investigation methodically.
balanced.description: Default mode - verification for action tasks

thorough.prompt_suffix: You have up to 40 tool calls for deep analysis. Double-check your work. Verify each step before proceeding.
thorough.description: Deep analysis with full verification for critical operations
